dataset_name: FDM printing configuration and peak tensile load
prompt:
Task: Estimate the mean peak tensile load measured for specimens made with this fused deposition modeling configuration.
Target: mean peak tensile load
Target unit: N
Input format: a JSON object. null means missing.
Field definitions and context: printer_chamber is the open or closed printer type. material names the filament. layer_height_mm is the nominal layer thickness in millimetres. infill_pct is the infill percentage and infill_pattern is its layout. print_speed_mm_per_s is the print speed in millimetres per second. The output is the configuration-level mean of three specimens tested under the source study protocol.
Input JSON: {"printer_chamber":"closed","material":"pla+","layer_height_mm":0.1,"infill_pct":20,"infill_pattern":"grid","print_speed_mm_per_s":30}
Return only one numeric prediction for the target.
